B.domain: Subtraction of fractions, mixed numbers, and whole numbers with simplification

skills.name: Find common denominator
skills.definition: Determine a common denominator and rewrite fraction parts as equivalent fractions before subtraction when denominators do not already match.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly finds an LCD or common denominator.
Tag when fraction parts are converted to equivalent fractions to match denominators before subtracting.
Tag for unlike-denominator fraction-only or mixed-number subtraction, even if the common denominator equals one original denominator.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag when denominators are already the same and no conversion is performed.
Do not tag mere subtraction of numerators after denominators already match.
Do not tag simplification of a fraction such as 4/10 to 2/5 unless it is used specifically as common-denominator conversion.

skills.name: Normalize given form
skills.definition: Rewrite a number into a more workable equivalent form before subtraction, such as converting an improper mixed number to a standard mixed number or simplifying a fraction part.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a mixed number with an improper fraction part is normalized, such as 2 3/2 to 3 1/2.
Tag when a fraction part inside a mixed number is simplified before subtraction, such as 4/10 to 2/5.
Tag only when the rewrite changes the original representation before the main subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag rewriting a whole number as a whole plus 0 over a denominator; that belongs to decomposition for mixed-form subtraction.
Do not tag finding equivalent fractions solely to create a common denominator; that belongs to S01.
Do not tag final simplification of the answer after subtraction.

skills.name: Decompose whole number
skills.definition: Rewrite a whole number as a whole part plus a zero-valued fractional part so it can be subtracted alongside a mixed number or fraction.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a whole number is rewritten as something like 3 + 0/5 or 2 + 0/8.
Tag when this decomposition is used to align whole and fractional parts in mixed-form subtraction.
Tag whether the whole number is the minuend or subtrahend.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary separation of an already-given mixed number into whole and fraction parts.
Do not tag borrowing from a whole part after subtraction has begun.
Do not tag normalization of improper mixed numbers; that belongs to S02.

skills.name: Subtract aligned parts
skills.definition: Carry out the subtraction once forms are aligned, including subtracting numerators of like-denominator fractions and subtracting whole parts and fraction parts of mixed numbers.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when like-denominator fractions are subtracted by subtracting numerators.
Tag when whole parts and fraction parts of mixed numbers are subtracted separately.
Tag when a mixed number minus a whole number or fraction is handled by subtracting the aligned whole and fractional components.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag steps whose main purpose is to create matching denominators; that belongs to S01.
Do not tag borrowing/regrouping steps used because the fractional subtraction would be negative; that belongs to S05.
Do not tag final recombination or simplification after subtraction is complete.

skills.name: Borrow across parts
skills.definition: Regroup one whole as an equivalent fraction and adjust the whole part when the fractional part of the minuend is too small to subtract the fractional part of the subtrahend.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly borrows 1 from the whole part.
Tag when 1 whole is converted into denominator-over-denominator and added to the fractional part.
Tag when borrowing resolves a negative fractional difference in mixed-number or whole-minus-fraction subtraction.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary subtraction when no regrouping is needed.
Do not tag rewriting a whole number as whole plus 0 over a denominator before subtraction; that belongs to S03.
Do not tag final combination of the adjusted whole and fraction parts.

skills.name: Simplify and combine
skills.definition: Express the result in lowest terms and in an appropriate final form by simplifying fractions, reducing zero fractional parts, and combining whole and fractional parts.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a fraction result is simplified to lowest terms, such as 9/12 to 3/4 or 0/3 to 0.
Tag when separate whole and fraction results are combined into a mixed number or integer.
Tag when a zero fractional or whole part is removed from the final answer.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag the subtraction itself before a result has been obtained.
Do not tag preliminary simplification of an operand before subtraction; that belongs to S02.
Do not tag common-denominator conversion; that belongs to S01.

exclusion_criteria: Do not tag preliminary normalization of an operand before subtraction; that belongs to S02.
Do not tag the subtraction itself; that belongs to S04.
Do not tag borrowing or regrouping; that belongs to S05.

A.domain: Subtracting fractions and mixed numbers, including unlike denominators, borrowing, normalization, and simplification

skills.name: Normalize nonstandard mixed numbers
skills.definition: Rewrite a mixed number with an improper fractional part as an equivalent standard mixed number before subtracting.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly converts a form like 2 3/2 or 1 4/3 into a standard mixed number.
Tag when the solver states 'normalize' and rewrites the mixed number by carrying whole units out of the fraction part.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary rewriting of a whole number as a whole plus 0 over a denominator.
Do not tag simplification of a reducible fraction such as 4/10 to 2/5 unless it changes an improper fraction part of a mixed number into standard mixed-number form.
Do not tag borrowing steps during subtraction.

skills.name: Create common denominator
skills.definition: Find a common denominator and convert fraction parts to equivalent fractions with that denominator before subtraction.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step finds an LCD or common denominator for unlike denominators.
Tag when a step converts one or both fractions to equivalent fractions with the common denominator.
Tag even if the denominators are already equal but the solver explicitly performs a common-denominator setup.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag subtraction of fractions that already share a denominator when no conversion is performed.
Do not tag simplification after subtraction.
Do not tag borrowing from the whole part.

skills.name: Subtract aligned fractions
skills.definition: Subtract fractions once they are expressed with a shared denominator, including cases where the denominator was already the same.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solver subtracts numerators over a common denominator.
Tag when the solver subtracts fraction parts of mixed numbers after denominators are aligned.
Tag when the fraction subtraction yields zero or a negative fractional result before any borrowing adjustment.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag the step of finding or creating the common denominator itself.
Do not tag subtraction of whole-number parts alone.
Do not tag simplification of the resulting fraction.

skills.name: Subtract whole parts
skills.definition: Subtract the whole-number components of the quantities when working with mixed numbers or whole numbers.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step explicitly subtracts whole parts such as 4 − 3 or 3 − 2.
Tag when a whole number is treated as the whole-part component in a mixed-number subtraction.
Tag when the whole-part subtraction is part of a larger mixed-number procedure, even if the fraction part is handled in the same step.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag pure fraction-only items with no whole-part subtraction.
Do not tag borrowing adjustments that reduce the whole part by 1; those belong to borrowing.
Do not tag final combining of whole and fractional parts into one answer.

skills.name: Borrow in mixed subtraction
skills.definition: Regroup one whole as an equivalent fraction to resolve a negative or insufficient fractional part during subtraction.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when the solver borrows 1 from the whole part and converts it to denominator-over-denominator form such as 5/5, 10/10, or 24/24.
Tag when borrowing is used after a fractional difference is negative or when subtracting a larger fraction from a smaller one.
Tag whether the minuend is a whole number, a mixed number, or a normalized mixed number.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag ordinary subtraction when no regrouping is needed.
Do not tag normalization of an improper mixed number before subtraction.
Do not tag simplification after the borrowed subtraction is completed.

skills.name: Simplify and express result
skills.definition: Reduce the result to lowest terms or an integer and present the final value in acceptable form.
inclusion_criteria: Tag when a step simplifies a fraction such as 9/12 to 3/4 or 0/3 to 0.
Tag when a step combines computed whole and fractional parts into a final mixed number or integer answer.
Tag when the final expression removes a zero whole part or zero fractional part.
exclusion_criteria: Do not tag intermediate subtraction steps that have not yet been expressed as the final result.
Do not tag conversion to common denominators.
Do not tag borrowing or normalization steps.
